positioning: Ultra-lightweight custom multi-task computer vision architecture and direct next-generation competitor to the YOLO family
modules: 2D anchor-free multi-scale detection (P3, P4, P5 strides 8, 16, 32)
RepConv reparameterizable 3x3 convolutions fused into single 3x3 convs for deployment
PartialChannelRepBlock (P-RepBlock) cutting FLOPs while preserving gradient diversity
Primary detection fast path bypassing auxiliary heads during pure detection inference
Multi-view EMA teacher (torch.no_grad) with multi-scale feature distillation
Class-balanced adaptive pseudo-label generator with predictive entropy filtering
Self-supervised photometric monocular depth loss (SSIM + L1 + edge-aware smoothness)
Cross-task 2D-3D geometric consistency and temporal motion stability
Self-supervised instance clustering over spatial, depth, and embedding affinity
RL / Bandit meta-controller for dynamic hyperparameter & resource budgeting
Adaptive compute router (early-exit) and knowledge distillation
Task-aligned SimOTA dynamic assignment
Complete IoU (CIoU) + DFL box regression
Multi-class Cross Entropy + Multiclass Dice with ignore-index
Morphological boundary loss on raw logits (Focal + Dice)
Discriminative instance embedding loss (L_var + L_dist + L_reg)
Mask quality self-assessment (IoU supervision SmoothL1)
Camera-aware DEM (inverse depth rho <-> metric depth Z)
Dense 3D pointcloud unprojection via camera intrinsics K
Oriented 3D IoU with rotated BEV polygon intersection
Object-specific 3D supervision on assigned positive detections
Multi-view geometric augmentation with inverse transform tracking
Confidence-weighted transform-aligned consistency loss
Lightweight bidirectional cross-task feature fusion
Adaptive uncertainty loss weighting with modality masking
COCO multi-task dataset adapter with polygon rasterization
Comprehensive evaluation metric suite: mAP50, mAP50:95, mIoU, Boundary F1, Depth RMSE/AbsRel
training_note: Multi-task trainer supports both supervised, semi-supervised, and self-supervised learning with EMA teacher distillation and detection-first inference bypass.
status: fully verified end-to-end; unit tests passing; overfit test converged; real benchmarks measured on RTX 5060 Laptop GPU (83 FPS Nano, 81 FPS Small)
publication_guidance: Benchmarks report verified FLOPs, parameter counts, memory, and CPU/GPU latency. Formal validation mAP/mIoU scores require a full 300-epoch training schedule on COCO/NYUv2. Comparative YOLO baseline is attributed as a state-of-the-art anchor-free 2D detection baseline.
